Subject: Cygnus MAP — Go-live phases, canary criteria & evaluation sprint plan

Elena / Tom,

Thanks again for the signature — attached is our first-pass post-signature execution package embedded in the MAP. I put the operational plan, evaluation sprint, and canary criteria together so we have a single source of truth for the next 6 weeks. High level: 

- Aim: staged rollout with 3 phased gates (Pilot -> Regional Canary -> Full) and measurable acceptance criteria at each gate.
- Evaluation: 2-week evaluation sprints aligned to each phase with predefined test sets and KPIs (latency P95, error rate, inference cost per 1k tokens, quality eval score on 6 CRs).
- Training & migration: trainer-led sessions for CS teams during pilot, then recorded trainings for wider user base; migration runbook includes backout window and data retention checks.

Action items for Cygnus:
1) Confirm procurement/PO ETA so we can reserve the Dedicated pool by 2026-07-09.
2) Review acceptance gates (sheet tab ‘Gates’) and confirm any additional success metrics by 2026-07-08.
3) Approve the proposed training cadence (week of 2026-07-19) or propose alternatives.

What’s attached: MAP_Cygnus_v1.xlsx (mutual action table + timeline), Canary_Checklist.pdf (operational checklist). I put a short runbook link in the related links.

Proposed schedule: internal dry run 2026-07-08, joint customer walkthrough 2026-07-09, pilot start 2026-07-12.

Ben / Marissa — can you take the lead on the canary monitoring configuration and training calendar respectively? Priyom / Stephanie — can you validate the rollback windows and POD sizing we recommend in tab ‘Infra’?

Thanks,

Naomi Feldman
Head of Customer Success

Naomi,

Appreciate the fast turnaround and the consolidated MAP. A few clarifications from our side before we sign off: 

- Training timing: we prefer the trainer-led sessions to be the week of 2026-07-26 so our clinical ops team can attend after a planned conference that week. Can you accommodate?
- Backout window: the runbook shows a 2-hour rollback window for the regional canary. Our legal/compliance folks want that to be explicit in the PO and also want an escalation contact list. Can you add the contact list and confirm SLA implications in the PO?
- Procurement: procurement@cygnusrx.com is starting the PO next week — current estimate is 7/14 for PO issuance, but I will push for 7/09 if needed. I’ll loop procurement on follow-ups.

Also: on the evaluation metrics, can you add a qualitative quality review step (3 subject-matter reviewers) to the pilot so we can validate hallucination risk on our clinical prompts?

Thanks,

Elena Rossi

Elena / team,

Quick notes on the canary proposal and monitoring specifics (i’m happy to own the canary run):

- Canary criteria (conservative): P95 latency <= 400ms, token error rate < 0.5%, inference cost < $0.012 per 1k tokens, and quality eval score >= 0.86 on pilot test set.
- Monitoring: we’ll push a canary metrics stack (Prometheus -> Grafana -> Alertmanager), with alerts for sustained P95 degradation (>3 consecutive 10-min windows) or errors spikes (>0.5% for 5 minutes).
- Rollback: 2-hour target for rollback is tight but achievable with our autoscaled Dedicated pool; we need a pre-approved backout plan in the MAP (I’ve added a backout checklist in canary-metrics.yaml).
- SME reviews: agree we should add 3 clinical reviewers during pilot; propose we schedule their qualitative review during the third day of pilot sprint so we can iterate before regional canary.

Attaching: canary-metrics.yaml (snippet) and linking the internal runbook here: https://wiki.redwood.com/runbooks/canary-monitoring

If procurement can push PO to 7/09 we can reserve capacity and hit the 7/12 pilot cadence. Otherwise we’ll need a small shift (pilot +1 week).

—Ben
Ben Carter
Principal SRE, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com

Elena / Team,

Thanks for the feedback — I’ve incorporated the procurements ask, the SME qualitative review, and the extended training week into the updated MAP and timeline. Attached is version 1.1 (MAP_Cygnus_v1.1.xlsx) — key changes included: 

- Mutual action table: firm dates for milestones (internal dry run 7/08 -> customer walkthrough 7/09 -> pilot 7/19 to accommodate training shift).
- Acceptance gates: explicit go/no-go checklist for each gate, with owner and ETA to resolve (max 48 hours).
- Canary criteria updated per Ben’s note and added a step for three SME reviewers during pilot (sheet ‘Pilot QC’).
- Procurement: added a PO contingency (reserve 48 hours of burst capacity if PO delayed past 7/14).
- Training: trainer roster attached (trainers-roster.csv) and a proposed 3-session cadence (live + office hours + recorded).

Next steps: Elena — please confirm procurement ETA and sign-off on the acceptance gates by EOD 7/09. If yes, I’ll circulate the DocuSign PO addendum and lock resource reservations.

If no, please propose the earliest date you can sign off and we’ll re-target pilot accordingly. We’re aiming for minimal drift while keeping the fallback clearly defined.

Marissa Cole
Implementation Lead, Redwood Inference
